provenance.base: synthetic ground-truth SCM for Workstream C (Finding 6b)
provenance.reason: Known-equation world so experiment 08 can audit declared actions through the true SCM rather than through an FCM the method also optimised against. The graph here is the exact data-generating process in src/data/load_synth_reach.py; it is not inferred.

notes: SYNTHETIC: the data-generating structural equations are known in closed form (src/data/load_synth_reach.py). income = 30 + 0.8*experience + 6*training + 0.15*age + eps; savings = 0.5*income + eps; approved = 1 iff 0.05*(income-60) + 0.08*(savings-30) + eps >= 0.

age is the one immutable ancestor and, by design, has NO edge into approved: decisive influence flows only through the directly-actionable income and savings, so every rejected applicant has a reachable, budget-feasible flip. The sibling world synth_block breaks exactly this property.
approved is a sink: no intervention may target a descendant of the prediction.
